<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>reconcile-project-sources</code></p>

Explain shared and private source drift and prepare one explicit transition that preserves both sides until apply.

## When to use

Explain drift between shared and private OpenSpec, changelog, or todo sources and prepare one explicit transition that preserves both until apply.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link reconcile-project-sources --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link reconcile-project-sources --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `changelog`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Explain source drift without merging configurations or exposing private content.
- Plan a verified promotion or relocation with explicit deletion boundaries.

## Examples

### Promote private project intent

**Prompt**

> Use the reconcile-project-sources skill to compare the private and shared intent sources and prepare a safe promotion plan.

**Expected outcome**

A reviewed plan identifies semantic drift, the target authority, verification, and any separate deletion.

### Preserve divergent task queues

**Prompt**

> Use the reconcile-project-sources skill to inspect shared and private todo queues without automatically merging them.

**Expected outcome**

Each queue remains independent and the report identifies only explicit actions the user may choose.
